title: Hugging Face Hub online mode is on
explanation: huggingface_hub is installed and offline mode isn't set in the image environment. Model, tokenizer and config loads try to reach huggingface.co (downloads, revision checks) and fail or stall in an air-gapped network.

evidence.detail: huggingface_hub 0.26.2 installed; not disabled in the image (none of HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1|true|yes|on, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1|true|yes|on)

fix: Bake the models into the image and set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 in the image environment.
